title: Job Tells Heavenly Father His Feelings
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who thinks deeply and holds onto hope, and tonight Job pours out his sad, confused feelings and still says his Redeemer lives: Wren tells Heavenly Father all about her grumpy day in her prayer and remembers that tomorrow is a fresh new day.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she thinks deeply and holds onto hope. In Wren’s world today: Wren had a hard day and felt grumpy inside. At bedtime, instead of keeping it in, she told Heavenly Father all about it in her prayer. Afterward, she felt lighter, and she remembered that tomorrow was a fresh new day. Just like Job shared his honest feelings and kept his hope, Wren learned that telling Heavenly Father everything brings peace.
